sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he does not want to press this application for the applicant No. 1, the husband of opp. party No. 2.
For the remaining applicant Nos. 2 to 5, It is submitted that they are family members and have been roped in unnecessarily just to put pressure on the entire family.
This application is disposed of with a direction that during the trial, the appearance of applicant Nos. 2 to 5 shall remain exempted.
